dataset.title: National-scale geodatabase of catchment characteristics in the Philippines for river management applications
dataset.methodNote: This is a modeled stream network and catchment dataset for 128 Philippine catchments, derived from 2013 IfSAR elevation data. It is not an authoritative named-waterbody boundary or field-surveyed local channel trace.

stationCrosscheck.sourceLocality: Mouth of Maalimango River, Barangay Ligtong I, Rosario, Cavite
stationCrosscheck.coordinateUse: The station's printed DMS coordinate was transformed for this internal proximity screen. The EIA datum was not established in the reviewed record; WGS 84 was assumed to compare it with the dataset. The coordinate itself is not repeated here.
stationCrosscheck.calculation: Transform the source station point to EPSG:3857 and measure planar point-to-polyline distance across the dataset's stream features. Approximate ground distance is the projected distance multiplied by cos(latitude).
stationCrosscheck.interpretation: The nearest modeled line is roughly 16 km away and belongs to a different named catchment. This is a poor geographic fit for the Rosario station and means this dataset does not provide a usable Maalimango channel trace at the mouth.

limitations: The station coordinate datum was not established in the reviewed source record; the WGS 84 transformation is an explicit screening assumption.
A distant nearest feature in a different catchment demonstrates poor fit for this dataset, not the absence of a local river or fish.
This modeled network cannot be used as the named channel boundary or to infer the whole river's extent, salinity, access or legal status.
No coordinates or source map were reproduced, and no species claims were changed.
nextAction: Seek permitted, higher-resolution channel geometry from NAMRIA, DENR or another documented source and compare it with the EIA's station-4 locality. Keep the 2016 mouth-station evidence research-only and Maalimango geometry unresolved until the channel trace and datum are independently validated.
